summary: International General Insurance Holdings Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) announcing a quarterly dividend increase from $0.05 to $0.075 per share, a 50% hike. The dividend will be paid on June 11, 2026, to shareholders of record on May 28, 2026. This is the third consecutive annual increase. The filing does not involve a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review. It is a routine capital return announcement, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, break fees, or regulatory clocks apply. This is a routine dividend adjustment, not a special situation.
